# HermOS IDE — Local-First Autonomous AI Agent IDE

> HermOS is an open-source, local-first desktop IDE where autonomous AI agents edit code, run terminal commands, and automate browsers directly on your machine with zero cloud telemetry.

## Quick Facts
- **License**: MIT (100% Free & Open Source)
- **Architecture**: Tauri 2.0 (Rust) + Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 + Prisma SQLite
- **Privacy**: 100% Local-First, Zero Remote Telemetry, API keys encrypted with AES-256-GCM and stored locally on your machine
- **Protocols**: Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for external tools, OpenAI API standard, Anthropic API, Ollama/vLLM local endpoints
- **Platforms**: Windows (.msi), macOS (.dmg universal), Linux (.deb amd64 / .AppImage)

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous Multi-Worker Subagents**: Dispatches background subagents that fork isolated workspace trees to research codebases, write unit tests, and verify builds concurrently.
- **Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK)**: Connects to flagship frontier and open-weight models through Anthropic Claude (Sonnet & Thinking series), Groq LPU (500+ T/s), NVIDIA NIM, and local offline engines (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio).
- **Embedded SQLite Telemetry Radar**: Tracks token consumption, cache hits, and execution times strictly on localhost with zero data sent to external servers.
- **Visual Git Diff & Checkpoint Manager**: Native git staging, visual unified split diff review, commit graph, and instant rollback.
- **Integrated Tooling**: Sandboxed terminal emulator, headless browser automation with DOM inspection, office document parsing, and dynamic MCP server discovery.
